$comment: The landing page (D-174, D-176): visual first, a few words each. The hero, up to five featured sections, and the closing line; the tiles and the buttons are in the view document (packages/views/views/siteLanding.view.json). Each image is a desktop scene: the app's window (apps/desktop/e2e/site-catalog.spec.ts) on the wallpaper (tools/site/scenes.py), light, and dark for visitors whose setting is dark. WP-10.5 writes the final words.
headline: Write. Nothing else.
line: A calm writing app. Your notes stay plain files in your own GitHub.

hero.alt: Focus Notes on a mountain desktop, in focus mode: the line being written stays clear while the rest of the essay fades back.

features.headline: Find anything. Instantly.
features.line: Notes, commands and settings, one keystroke away.

image.alt: Spotlight open over a note, finding the Garden folder and its notes as you type.

features.headline: Make it yours.
